# BBC

> > The British Broadcasting Corporation's regional hubs delivering news, sports, culture, and programming across the UK's nations and languages.

BBC provides comprehensive regional coverage through dedicated portals for Northern Ireland, Scotland, Wales, Alba (Scottish Gaelic), and Cymru (Welsh language), serving diverse communities with localized news, sports including rugby union and football, and cultural programming in English, Irish, Welsh, and Scottish Gaelic.

## Key Topics

- Regional news coverage
- Northern Ireland politics and news
- Scottish Gaelic broadcasting
- Welsh language programming
- Rugby union coverage
- UK nations and regions
- Gaelic cultural content
- Local politics and MLAs
- BBC Wales and BBC Scotland
- Irish language services
- Sports coverage (football, rugby)
- Celtic and Rangers football
- WRU (Welsh Rugby Union)
- Radio Ulster and Radio Cymru
- Regional BBC hubs

## UK Regional Hubs

- [BBC - Northern Ireland - Home](https://www.bbc.com/northernireland): BBC NI regional hub: news, sport, Radio Ulster/Foyle, Irish & Gaelic content
- [BBC - Scotland - Home](https://www.bbc.com/scotland): BBC Scotland regional hub: news, politics, Rangers/Celtic & sports coverage
- [BBC - Wales - Home](https://www.bbc.com/wales): BBC Wales regional hub: news, WRU rugby, TV shows & digital content

## Gaelic and Welsh Language Services

- [BBC - Alba - Home](https://www.bbc.com/alba): BBC Alba: Scottish Gaelic broadcasting, culture, news & programmes
- [BBC - Cymru - Home](https://www.bbc.com/cymru): BBC Cymru: Welsh-language news, Radio Cymru & cultural programming
